reference.name: Forge Developer Terminal Workspace.png
reference.caveat: AI-generated raster reference; text and exact typography are not authoritative application state. Measurements are approximate.

scope.outer_shell: Shared by Block and Chat; Ember/Frost continue using reference_shell.
scope.publication: Local commits and Library backup only for this batch; published master checkpoints remain unchanged.

geometry.bounds_tolerance: Measured raster edges are estimates, usually within about2px; no unsupported exact font/kernel provenance claim.

typography.content_size_units: absolute logical pixels, not12pt and not an artificial transform
typography.default_UI: 14pt, scale1; independent from missing Main/UI font inheritance
typography.configured_values: Preserve explicit font strings and their pixel/point units. Never rewrite daily user configuration.
migration_boundary: Missing UI values now use14pt/scale1 instead of inheriting only-Main font/zoom.
Authored content uses a12px nominal baseline. Explicit configured native font sizes remain actual native sizes, while authored relative text extents can change from the prior14pt baseline.
Settings font-size edits must preserve absolute/point units, native grid/cursor/text and independent Main/UI zoom authority.

constraints: Search must shrink/hide to a reachable launcher without forcing a wide minimum window.
Tool captions can compact while actions/tooltips and one send/stop owner remain reachable.
One empty input row may use68px minimum; multiline input grows within bounds and keeps the actual caret visible.

running_output.goal: One real command header, output-only body and separate noncopying logical-line gutter.
guards: Use actual PTY/FTCS execution and source boundaries; never delete text by matching a fixture command.
One ActiveVTE/PTY retains input, IME and cancellation authority.
Interactive/fullscreen or ambiguous output retains the complete native terminal; no hard crop of real programs.
Preserve ANSI, native selection/copy, fractional reading anchors and streaming viewport culling.
